avenger.charged: explicit boolean; false consumes/clears; play the independent burst at authoritative attack contact

shieldKnight.remaining: integer 0..3; displayed directly, never decremented by rendering

commander.allies: authoritatively resolved actor references; only living same-team actors are shown

effects.ordering: Strictly increasing revision per role/source actor, stable battleId; stale or other-battle states are ignored
effects.lifecycle: Use existing engine timeline; engine cancel/hide and destroy clear state sprites. Recreate the manager for a new battle identity. Seek samples current active state; it does not reconstruct gameplay history.
effects.memory: Shares reference-counted atlas owner with one-shot effects. 32MiB unused-cache budget; active owners are not evicted.
